chapter.verse: Mihingte' kiangpan ahilo, mihing' thu tawh zong ahilo, Jesu Khris leh misite' lakpan amah a thokiksak Pa Pasian' thu tawh sawltak khat ahi keimah Paul leh
kei' kianga om sanggamte khempeuh in Galatia gama om pawlpite kong hopih uh hi.
Note' tungah hehpihna hong tung henla i Pa Pasian leh Topa Jesu Khris' kiangpan nopna lemna hong om ta hen.
Tua Topa pen i Pasian leh i Pa' deihna tungtawnin hih khanghun siahuai pan eite hong hotkhiat nadingin amahmah eite' mawhna taangin hong kipiatawm hi.
Tua Topa in a tawntung a tawntungin minpha ngah ta hen. Amen.
Note Khris' hehpihna tawh hong sam Pasian manlangtak nusia-in Lungdamna Thu a dang khat na san uh lamdang kong sa hi.
A taktakin Lungdamna Thu a dang khat a om hilo a, note hong lungbuaisak nuam, Khris' Lungdamna Thu a lumlet nuam, mi kimkhat om ahih man hi.
Himah taleh ko ka hi uh-a vantung pan vanmi khat ahi phial zongin note' kianga kong tangko uh Lungdamna Thu tawh a kipelh khat hong tangko a om leh samsiat tuak ta hen.
Kong gen ngeisa mah bangun tu-in zong kong genkikun ah: na sansa uh Lungdamna Thu tawh a kipelh khat hong tangko peuhmah samsiat tuak ta hen.

A hang pen tu-in mihing' pahtakna leh Pasian' pahtakna, kei' zon koi hizaw hiam? Ahihkeileh mi' lungkim nading hanciam ka hi hiam? Mi' lungkim nading a hanciam lai ka hihleh kei pen Khris' sila ka hikei ding hi.
A hang pen sanggamte aw, keima' kong tangko Lungdamna Thu pen mihing' patkhiat Lungdamna Thu hilo cih kong theisak nuam hi.
Hih pen kuamah' kiangpan ka ngah hilo, kuamah ii hong hilh zong hilo, Jesu Khris' tungpan mangmuhna khat tawh ka ngah ahi hi.
A hang pen Jew biakna sung ka om lai-a ka gamtatzia, Pasian' pawlpi nasiatak bawlsia-in suksiat ding ka hanciamna thu, na za khinzo uh hi.
Kei pen ka mipihte lak, keima' khangual tampite sangin Jew biakna ah ka mainawtzaw a, ka pupite' zatngeizia thute zong genzawhloh lawpna tawh ka zui hi.
Ahih hangin ka nu' gilsung pan kei hong tengkhia-in a hehpihna tawh kei hong samkhia Pasian in
Gentile mite' kiangah ama' Tapa' thu ka tangko theih nadingin kei' tungah ama' Tapa hong laak ciangin si le sa' tungah thudotna ka nei kei a,
kei' ma-a sawltak ahi khinte' omna Jerusalem ah zong paito tuanlo-in thakhatin Arabia gamsung va pai-in tua panin Damascus ka ciahkik hi.
Tua nungah kum thum khit ciangin Cephas' kiangah hawh dingin Jerusalem ka paito a, ama' kiangah ni sawmlenga ka taam hi.
Ahi zongin Topa' sanggampa James longal sawltak dangte kuamah ka mu kei hi.
(Tu-a kong gelhte zuau hilo cih Pasian in hong thei hi.)
Tua ciangin Syria leh Cilicia gamte ah ka pai hi.
Khris sunga om Judea pawlpite in mimalin kei hong thei nailo uh a,
“Eite hong bawlsia den mipa in tu-in ama' suksiat sawm ngei upna thu tangko hi,” cih thu bek a za uh ahi hi.
Tua hi a, amaute in keima' hangin Pasian' min phat uh hi.
